questions.q: 9. If the number 55p1067q9 is exactly divisible by 99, then pq is equal to:
questions.s:
9.(a)

55p1067q9 is exactly divisible by 99 that means divisible by 9 and 11 both.

For divisibility of 9 sum of digits of number must be divisible by 9.

so 5+5+p+1+0+6+7+q+9 = 33 +p+q must be divisible by 9 .

33+p+q must be a multiple of 9 so 33+p+q either 36 or 45 that means p+q = 3,12 —-(i)

55p1067q9 is divisible by 11 that means (5+p+0+7+9 ) - (5 +1+6+q) must be 0 or 11.

so 21 +p - 12-q = 0 or 11

p -q = -9 + 11 = 2 —--(ii)

From (i) and (ii),

p = 7 and q = 5

p×q = 7×5 = 35

⇒ x + y = 9 ---- (i)
Then ,

questions.q: 8. There are two classrooms, A and B. If 7 students are shifted from A to B, then B will have twice the number of students as A. If 3 students are sent from B to A, then both the classrooms will have the same number of students. The positive difference between the number of students in the two classrooms is:
questions.s:
8.(a)
Let no. of students in classrooms A and B are ‘a’ and ‘b’ respectively.
According to the first condition,
2 (a-7) = b+7
⇒ 2a - b = 21
According to the second condition,
a+3 = b-3
⇒ b-a = 6
Hence, a = 27 and b = 33
Required difference = 33 -27 = 6

तो, 21 +p - 12-q = 0 or 11

p -q = -9 + 11 = 2 —--(ii)

(i) और (ii) से,

p = 7 और q = 5

p×q = 7×5 = 35

questions_hin.q_hi: 1. 1 के अलावा एक-अंकीय संख्या ज्ञात करें, जो संख्या 17³ + 18³ − 16³ − 15³ को पूर्णतः विभाजित कर सकती है।

If (x+3)(x-1) are factors of 2x3+ax2-bx-4,then find the ratio of a/b.

यदि 2x3+ax2-bx-4 के कारक (x + 3) (x-1) हैं, तो a / b का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
As x+3 is a factor, putting x+3=0, x=-3 in given expression it must come zero.

2x3+ax2-bx-4=0

2(-3)3+a(-3)2-b(-3)-4=0

-54+9a+3b-4=0

9a+3b=58....(1)

Similarly putting x-1=0,x=1 is given expression

2x3+ax2-bx-4=0

2(1)3+a(1)2-b(1)-4=0

2+a-b-4=0

a-b=2....(2)

Solving equation 1 and 2 we get, a=16/3,b= 10/3

a:b=8:5

questions_hin.q_hi: 8. दो कक्षाएँ A और B हैं। यदि 7 विद्यार्थियों को A से B में स्थानांतरित किया जाता है, तो B में A से दोगुनी संख्या में विद्यार्थी होंगे। यदि 3 विद्यार्थियों को B से A में भेजा जाता है, तो दोनों कक्षाओं में विद्यार्थियों की संख्या समान हो जाएगी। दोनों कक्षाओं में विद्यार्थियों की संख्या के बीच धनात्मक अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
8.(a)
माना कक्षाओं में छात्रों की संख्या A और B क्रमशः "a" और "b" हैं।
पहली स्थिति के अनुसार,
2 (a-7) = b+7
⇒ 2a - b = 21
दूसरी स्थिति के अनुसार,
a+3 = b-3
⇒ b-a = 6
अतः, a = 27 और b = 33
आवश्यक अंतर = 33 -27 = 6

questions_hin.q_hi:
18. व्यंजक x4-8x2+m एक पूर्ण वर्ग होगा जब m का मान _______ होगा।

SSC CHSL 08/06/2022 ( Morning )
questions_hin.s_hi:
18.(b)

x4 - 8x2+ m एक पूर्ण वर्ग है।

पूर्ण वर्ग = a2 - 2ab + b2

2ab = 8x2, यहां a = x2

अतः b = 4

x4 - 8x2+ m = a2 - 2ab + b2

m = b2 = (4)2= 16
